# Third-party baseline sources (pinned)

Copies of the upstream baseline checkouts that the SCA runs used on TACC Vista, taken on 2026-10-31 without `.git/`,
`__pycache__/` or README images (`assets/`, DyPE `collage.png`). `git status` was clean in every checkout at the pinned
commit, so none of them carries a local patch. Everything SCA changes about a baseline lives in our own adapters,
listed in the last column.

| Baseline | Upstream | Pinned commit | Copy here | Vista path used by the runs | SCA adapter |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AReA | https://github.com/KooroshRH/AReA | `9e38ec2d8457f2aa7800766e8a22d4960f160c69` | `third_party/AReA/` | `/scratch/09032/saini_2/sca/third_party/AReA` (env `AREA_DIR`) | `scripts/run_area.py` |
| UltraImage | https://github.com/thu-ml/DiT-Extrapolation (`flux/`) | `586ae882099ee768e9bbc6757118d572a1e71b25` | `third_party/UltraImage/` | `/scratch/09032/saini_2/constancy_rope/third_party/UltraImage/flux` (env `ULTRA_DIR`) | `scripts/run_ultraimage.py` |
| DyPE | https://github.com/guyyariv/DyPE | `436fe612fb7695fa2d5dc32d63390c048ba6033c` | `third_party/DyPE/` | `/scratch/09032/saini_2/constancy_rope/third_party/DyPE` (env `CROPE_THIRD_PARTY`, tests only) | reimplemented in constancy_rope `crope/rope.py` (frozen copy `code/crope_c05ebdc` on HF `sca-frozen-code`) |
| SEGA | https://github.com/rajabi2001/sega | `ddaab08552c7b7ceba2ebd8f579a0f65dee90b5e` | `third_party/sega/` | `/scratch/09032/saini_2/constancy_rope/third_party/sega` | constancy_rope `crope/sega_official.py` (method `sega_official`) |
| HRDiT | https://github.com/zylwithxy/HRDiT | `f3be935da797c7dc98ecff07cf4a5f01e1ddb51d` | `repro/baseline_expansion_20261017/vendor/hrdit/` | same | `repro/baseline_expansion_20261017/run.py` (method `hrdit_dev_author`) |
| SigMa | https://github.com/bxuanz/SigMa | `fbe3a863c20b24fd870c9912e77ce0e39e85e1b4` | `repro/baseline_expansion_20261017/vendor/sigma/` | same | `repro/baseline_expansion_20261017/run.py` (method `sigma_dev_matched`) |

HRDiT and SigMa file-level hashes are in `repro/baseline_expansion_20261017/sources.json`.

Notes
- UltraImage needs a block-averaged attention cache (`ULTRA_BLOCKAVG_ROOT`, default
  `/scratch/09032/saini_2/sca/cache/ultraimage_blockavg`, 270 GB). It is regenerated by the first pass of
  `scripts/run_ultraimage.py` and was not migrated.
- Upstream SEGA ships no license file. The copy is kept only so this private repository can rerun the baseline; drop
  `third_party/sega/` and fetch the pinned commit instead if the repository is ever made public.
- To restore the Vista layout: `export AREA_DIR=$PWD/third_party/AReA ULTRA_DIR=$PWD/third_party/UltraImage/flux`
  (see `MIGRATION.md`).
